items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I played against them with Charlie Barnet, doing the Worlds Fair in '39

ctx.x: Okay, because we were talking about Charlie Barnet and we've been talking about Charlie Webster, Shavers, and we want to know which Charlie you're talking about.

Oh, I can tell them about John Kirby's name is that they'll have to use research, because I can't get in -- John Kirby was a big hit at the time, 52nd Street, the old Congress Hotel, and I remember he had Buster Bailey, Russell Procope -- Buster Bailey was a great clarinetist that used to be with the original Fletcher Henderson band from Chicago -- among others. Russell Procope, a great alto saxophonist, was still in the driver's seat around New York, and --
And the only living ex-member of the John Kirby band.
